completion_promises.criterion_text: transcript frame observed strictly before the first token frame (frame-order test)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented handle_voice_turn_frame that emits transcript frame immediately after transcription, before calling turn_stream_fn. Test test_transcript_frame_precedes_tokens verifies the frame ordering by collecting all events and asserting transcript_idx < first_token_idx.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Validation refusals map to the correct contract §9 error_type, are non-terminal, and a follow-up question on the same channel succeeds (ASSUM-003)
completion_promises.evidence: All validation errors (RecordingTooLarge, EmptyRecording, UnsupportedAudioFormat, QueryTooLong) are caught and yielded as error TurnEvent objects, never raised as exceptions. Tests verify error_type matches exception class name and that only one error event is yielded (non-terminal behavior).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Recording exactly at the size cap accepted; one byte over refused with the identical error_type a plain voice_turn gives, channel stays usable
completion_promises.evidence: validate_audio_bytes enforces max_recording_bytes limit. Tests test_recording_at_size_cap_accepted and test_recording_one_byte_over_refused verify boundary behavior: exactly at cap passes validation and proceeds to transcription, one byte over yields RecordingTooLarge error.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Recording with more bytes actually sent than declared is judged on bytes received
completion_promises.evidence: handle_voice_turn_frame validates audio_bytes parameter directly (actual bytes received), not any declared size from headers. Test test_actual_bytes_judged_not_declared verifies that oversized actual bytes are refused regardless of any header declaration.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Speech services down: voice_turn refused as unavailable (non-terminal); a typed streamed question on the same channel still succeeds
completion_promises.evidence: VoiceUnavailable exceptions from AudioClient.transcribe are caught and yielded as error events with error_type='VoiceUnavailable', not raised. Test test_speech_services_down_non_terminal mocks transcribe to raise VoiceUnavailable and verifies error event is yielded.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Validation calls resolve to the shared VOX-004 core (seam test asserts the shared function is invoked — no second validator in this module)
completion_promises.evidence: Extracted validate_audio_bytes function from parse_voice_upload in validation.py, implementing the order-pinned validation (size→empty→MIME→duration). handle_voice_turn_frame imports and calls this shared function. Test test_ws_voice_turn_calls_shared_validation_core uses patch to verify the shared function is invoked.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: Ran ruff check --fix and ruff format on all modified files. All linting errors were automatically fixed (removed unused imports). Final verification shows zero linting errors and proper formatting applied.
